paragraphs.text: Four Star Trek Commander decks will be released together with Star Trek on November 13, 2026.
1 ready-to-play deck of 100 Magic cards 18 new-to- Magic cards, including 2 traditional foil cards
A deck centered around drawing cards and Spacecraft . Thematically, the deck is centered around Captain Jean-Luc Picard and the Star Trek: The Next Generation series.
A deck centered around landfall . Thematically, the deck is centered around the Star Trek: The Original Series series.
A deck centered around an aggro strategy. Thematically, the deck is centered around the Klingons .
A deck centered around assimilate and go-wide strategies. Thematically, the deck is centered around the Borg .
Non-foil tokens can be found in the Commander deck, while traditional foil tokens are obtained from Collector Boosters .
